interpretation: Trial site can be represented as Facility and located geographically without collapsing it into Organization; Gate-D disjointness is verified separately by the frozen ontology build gate.
No ClinicalStudy type or explicit study-sponsorship relation exists in the frozen ontology.
Pharmaceutical identity distinctions are preserved, but an Intervention context/type is absent.
ObservationResult is intentionally not equated with a clinical-trial Outcome; explicit trial-outcome semantics are absent.
Reason text/evidence can be preserved, but explicit shortage-has-reason semantics are missing.
Temporal primitives exist, but source lifecycle statuses and posting/update/change/discontinued dates are not fully typed as domain lifecycle semantics.
Essentiality is represented contextually rather than as an intrinsic drug kind.
Essential classification can be scoped to India as a jurisdiction.
Form/strength distinctions are available, but NLEM medicine/active-moiety granularity may not equal a marketed presentation.
No explicit HealthcareLevel type or medicine-applicable-at-healthcare-level relation exists.
